issue213.title: [Task] S4-T18 — Verify fallback/account isolation and complete core preflight
issue213.body:
### Parent story
#18

### What needs to be done
#### Work package A — Verify rating degradation, cold start and account isolation
Run cross-story integration after rating enhancement; distinguish catalogue failure, rating failure and no preferences.



#### Work package B — Complete actual core preflight before optional trailer Go
Own the pre-G4 verification previously staged under C04/C05: use #219's reviewed/merged EARLY_TEST_SETUP, completed #195 existing UI/stars and all completed core feature/acceptance dependencies to run real core CI/default pytest/extended backend/frontend tests/lint/build and independent clean-clone/setup/environment checks. Do not wait for #218 or #219 final closure.

Verify all six P0 plus rating/ranking, Similar/Search, profile/reset, watchlist, existing backdrop, full-set page/filter/return/auth/privacy regressions on one core candidate. Inspect complete UI in light/dark at mobile/tablet/desktop and real loading/empty/error/retry states; user-visible fake success is never accepted. Independently follow committed SETUP in a new folder; root pytest is token-free/offline/temporary-DB, while actual dev/demo catalogue import uses a private server-side operator token and a separate redacted provenance/count/ID/time smoke. Do not expose secrets or use M2 seed as live catalogue acceptance.

Record tested SHA/tool versions/environment/commands/expected-actual/full output, independent reviewer, current migration/index/text/config revision and safe startup/health. A failed required check blocks core acceptance/G4; fix/retest affected implementation rather than mark Pending as Pass. Provide a documented Go-ready/Defer recommendation and actual remaining author/reviewer/final-regression capacity to PO/SM. Their explicit G4 decision is required before #214 starts; this issue itself does not implement trailer or own final report/submission. #219 later rechecks the selected final candidate and #218 audits all evidence.

- [S4-T01 #195](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/195) — completed, reviewed and merged.
- [S4-T03 #198](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/198) — completed, reviewed and merged.

- [S4-T16 #211](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/211) — completed, reviewed and merged.
- [S4-T17 #212](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/212) — completed, reviewed and merged.
- The only early infrastructure exception: #219's reviewed/merged EARLY_TEST_SETUP output (root pytest/isolated fixtures/build/environment baseline), not #219 completion. This issue owns the actual pre-G4 core CI/clean-clone/build preflight.

### Execution and closure — approved 24 October 2026
Approved dependency-table layer: 9. Approved by the PO on 24 October 2026: implement, test, independently review and merge this issue's complete scoped output, then close it. Dependencies below refer to completed/accepted issues, not former intermediate checkpoints. No downstream task waits for an early slice of this issue, and this issue does not remain Open merely to style future features or collect later dossier evidence. Several commits/PRs are permitted within the same implementation effort; do not force a single huge PR or close before the required checks pass. A preparatory PR uses Refs; only completion uses Closes. This planning edit does not close an issue, tick acceptance, change assignees or claim tests pass.

### Completion checks — all original outputs retained
- [ ] Through real API and browser, rating-only failure preserves a BR2-valid preference baseline; catalogue failure remains Error/Retry.
- [ ] No ratings does not block the flow; popular cold-start and no-match alternatives retain A90/B80/C80 order regardless of account ratings.
- [ ] Saving a rating then returning refetches the current account's list; genre choices remain saved across details, retry and login.
- [ ] HTTP 401 cannot be treated as empty/no-match data or retried under the old account.
- [ ] Provide focused automated tests for changed behaviour and reproducible reviewer steps.
- [ ] Link the tested commit and independent review; record unimplemented Story criteria explicitly.
- [ ] Record focused test commands, actual expected/observed results, tested SHA and independent review.
- [ ] Merge only after the applicable checks pass. Automated fixtures stay synthetic, with no live TMDb/token dependency.


- [ ] Re-run/trace at least three meaningful root pytest cases for EACH of #18 and #20, including normal success, business/auth refusal and applicable numeric boundaries, authored during implementation before #200's audit. Fill any later integration gaps here; never make #200 wait for this issue or count only 5xx as business refusal.
- [ ] Use 25-movie 10/10/5 fixtures and around-limit values to prove full-set order, no duplicate pages, public alphabetical versus popular fallback modes and correct no-match semantics. Tests are deterministic and temp-DB/fake-repo isolated without server/network.
- [ ] Link TC-IDs, actual test nodes/authors/commands/SHA/expected-actual and meaningful mutation validation; retain browser/header/navigation evidence separately and keep all original account/rating degradation checks.

Scoped implementation, author tests, independent review/acceptance where specified, reproducible commands, expected/actual results, tested executable SHA, API/DB/browser or UI evidence and updated implementation contracts. CI remains synthetic/mock at provider boundaries, offline/token-free with an isolated real DB. Reuse S3 code/evidence; do not count existing Story Points again.

@anotify-vie / @NguyenTuanAnh0608

3 provisional author hours: sum of the original 1 work package(s), not a scope reduction. 0.5h independent review reserved separately. Reforecast under C01 before implementation; keep the existing correction buffer.

C01 must reforecast this issue's actual retained/transferred scope, tests and independent review before commitment. Former whole-UI/final-contract/preflight/TDD coordination hours move with their outputs; they are not silently deleted or counted twice. Preserve correction buffer and distinguish the previous M4/watchlist/stars baselines from current approved availability.

### Planned sprint / Scope
Sprint 4. Task/Chore Points blank. All unchanged Story AC, failure/security checks and DoD remain required. Optional not admitted stays Deferred/Open, not falsely Done.

Pending. Add real PR/test/review/candidate/event links. A planning document, mockup, intermediate milestone or partial checklist is not final acceptance.

### Sprint 4 coordination
- Owner: @anotify-vie; independent reviewer: @NguyenTuanAnh0608. If a reviewer coauthors a PR, select another substantive non-coauthor reviewer.
- Follow the approved one-pass scope/dependencies in this live issue and [S4-C01 #216](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/216)/[S4-C03 #217](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/217). Older local/ignored context using checkpoint dependencies is superseded for workflow only; all original functional/security/test outputs remain assigned below.
- Runtime reads the mandatory TMDb-imported local SQLite catalogue. Token stays server-side; CI uses synthetic/mock external boundaries and isolated DB, offline/token-free. No new features from the reference ZIP.
- Estimates are historical baselines, not approved capacity after responsibility redistribution and M4 scope. C01 must reforecast current author/review/test/document work without changing native assignees or rewriting past commitments.
- Mandatory core: complete every scoped check and independent review. Existing Story AC/DoD and Story Points are unchanged.

### Milestone 4 rubric amendment — 23 October 2026
#### M4 P0 S02/S04 pytest coverage
For [#18/S02](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/18) and [#20/S04](https://github.com/SE-FDA-NEU/ai66a_group3_C1_SE/issues/20) reuse/add root tests/ pytest cases with TC-IDs for normal matching/fallback, business/auth refusal and numeric bounds. Each Story needs at least three documented cases, not one shared three-case group. Distinguish 401/invalid page-size or other reviewed validation refusal from 5xx service failure; system failures/no-data/fallback remain additional important tests.

Preserve current post-M3 behaviour: rank the complete set before page slicing, 25 eligible/source movies paginate 10/10/5 with no cross-page repeats, limit-boundary cases around 10 use actual validation, and public Home is alphabetical while fallback is popularity/title/ID. No-match is based on the complete genre-matched base set, not an empty view-filter page. Keep no-preferences versus saved-preferences transitions, no fabricated results, A/B isolation and retry.
Use fake repositories or real temporary SQLite and in-process TestClient; no live token/TMDb/server/date-dependent fixture. Keep actual browser evidence for navigation/labels/header state and do not present API-only tests as rendered UI proof. C01/C03 assign/specify baseline S02/S04 P0 cases and members author them during implementation before #200's completed audit. This issue revalidates them on the core integrated candidate and sends final mapping/effectiveness/output to #218. #200 must not wait for this issue's closure; genuine evidence is retained, not deferred or fabricated.
